column1: # Seconds each test file takes on a macos-latest runner (the slowest job in the matrix), read through
# scripts/ci-weights.sh to balance shards and to start the heaviest files first. Measured from CI
# logs' "::group::<file> (Ns, …)" lines; a file never measured there is estimated from its local
# seconds, and a split file gets its parent's seconds by its share of the parent's tests. A file
# missing here is weighted 5s per @test. Refresh when a shard runs far longer than the others.
